cohort_policy_details: Select every listed season/game_type cohort and the declared date range; retain every source-frame game in the inclusion/exclusion ledger.

Exclude an entire candidate game for quarantine/unreconstructed status, incomplete game, critical or unknown reconstruction quality, unknown outcome, flagged/incomplete row provenance, or unassigned live control.
Retain explicit administrative unassigned references when unassigned_control_events is exactly false; no source rows disappear.
Preserve all selected game rows, original possession numbers and supplied prior-global histories; never drop individual outcomes or reindex.
Selection is provisional data availability/quality, not scientific eligibility; conditional selection may bias results.

Keep context nulls explicit with fixed missing indicators and training-only median imputation; the first two possessions of each game are excluded from both models at design time and counted per season.

Team fouls and penalty state are derived during the run from the re-verified raw archives with the unchanged parser; the fit is withheld unless the derived defense count equals the exported research count on every selected row.
limitations: Follows the agreed project_plan Stage 5 on the archived 2020-21 to 2024-25 seasons; every season was analyzed in earlier project work, so this is retrospective development evidence, not an unused or confirmatory cohort.
Local plan saved and pushed before the first plan-stage5-v1 fit; not an authenticated preregistration.
Reconstruction and every game remain independently unvalidated; no independent audit or game-error bound is claimed. Quality selection keeps about 63% of games and may bias results.
Team fouls and penalty state are reconstructed from final play-by-play under NBA Rule 12, not official live bonus flags.
Paired whole-game intervals condition on the fitted models and assume independent games within each test season; no refitting, selection or calendar/series correction and no guaranteed coverage.
The playoff indicator cannot be learned because no training fold contains playoff games; only 2024-25 playoffs are archived.

Only retrospective prediction of recorded counted defensive fouls; no call-correctness, referee-intent or causal conclusion. Actual results stay in ignored local outputs; no deployment or public scientific claim.

bootstrap.pooled: rng = numpy default_rng(seed); for each test season in fold order, one call rng.integers(n_games, size=(resamples, n_games)) on that season's games sorted by game_id; per draw, sum of resampled paired game loss sums over all seasons divided by sum of resampled game possession counts; numpy quantile (linear) at 0.025, 0.975
bootstrap.season: same procedure on one season with rng = numpy default_rng([seed, k]) for test fold k = 1, 2, 3

context_definitions.team_fouls_and_penalty: team_fouls.states: NBA Rule 12 B.V quota 4 regulation / 3 overtime, one free foul in the last two minutes, parser event order

model_specification.history: recent_defensive_foul = 1 if previous_foul_1 == 1 or previous_foul_2 == 1 else 0
model_specification.paired_rows: first two possessions of each game excluded from both models (meeting_ab.check_lags)
model_specification.preprocessing: training-only median imputation with fixed missing indicators for every numeric context column; standardize all numeric columns; one-hot teams, unseen teams all zeros
model_specification.primary: pooled possession-weighted mean of logloss(history_b) - logloss(context_a); negative favors history
secondary: games, possessions, counted foul events, prevalence
model_specification.shared_C: Model A trained on validation train seasons; lowest validation log loss; first grid value breaks ties; applied unchanged to both models in every test fold
model_specification.source_document: Google Doc project_plan (Crimson Indigo workspace), sections 3 and 5, last edited 2026-10-23
